quote: GitLab's Fiscal Year runs from February 1 to January 31.
fact: GitLab's fiscal year starts on February 1 and ends on January 31.

quote: the scheduled payment date is the 22nd of each month
fact: Non-US contractors paid through iiPay are paid on the 22nd of each month.

quote: Please use the `#cfo-approvals` chat channel in Slack for alerting the CFO to a request for his approval
fact: Requests needing CFO approval are flagged in the #cfo-approvals Slack channel.

quote: expense claims over 90 days from purchase date will not be reimbursed unless approved by your Manager
fact: Expense claims filed more than 90 days after purchase are not reimbursed unless the manager approves.

quote: US Team Members are required to only submit receipts for any expenses over $50 USD.
fact: US team members need receipts only for expenses over $50; non-US team members need receipts for all expenses.

quote: Due to the nature of their roles, E-Group members have a maximum monthly limit to be reimbursed of $20K USD before additional approvals are required.
fact: E-Group members can be reimbursed up to $20K a month before extra approval is needed, versus $10K for other team members.

quote: Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7 day booking lead time.
fact: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to $300 per night including tax, booked 7 days ahead.

quote: Meals while traveling on Company business  are reimbursable, up to $120 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day.
fact: Meals while traveling on company business are reimbursed up to $120 per day.

quote: new hires will receive a 1,500 USD (or equivalent local currency) stipend to help you towards setting up your home office in your first year
fact: New hires get a 1,500 USD home office stipend for their first year.

quote: Starting July 15, 2026, GitLab no longer reimburses personal VPN subscriptions (such as ExpressVPN, Proton, Mullvad, and similar services) through expense claims.
fact: From July 15, 2026, personal VPN subscriptions are no longer reimbursed; team members use the company VPN NordLayer instead.

quote: The allowable cost for gifts is up to $125 USD (including shipping) per gift.
fact: Managers can expense gifts or flowers for a team member's significant life event up to $125 including shipping; baby gifts are excluded because GitLab already sends one.

quote: All costs associated with attending a conference to represent GitLab are reimbursable and an approved completed [G&D issue](/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/) will need to be noted in the expense report upon submission.
fact: Conference costs are reimbursed only with an approved Growth and Development (G&D) issue noted on the expense report.

quote: Team Member laptops can be refreshed after three years of employment.
fact: Team member laptops can be refreshed after three years; damage replacements need an IT issue first.

quote: Team Members are prohibited from providing anything of value, including meals, to any government official, government Team Member, or government representative (including any government prospects and government customers).
fact: Team members may not buy meals or anything of value for government officials, including government prospects and customers.

quote: Accidental Death | 5× Annual Salary (up to USD 500,000)
fact: The business travel accident policy pays 5 times annual salary for accidental death, capped at USD 500,000.

quote: US-embargoed countries currently include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, and Syria
fact: Team members may not take company devices to or work from US-embargoed countries such as Cuba, Iran, North Korea and Syria.

quote: Over $250K: Procurement led RFP, typically 5+ vendor bids
fact: Purchases over $250K require a Procurement-led RFP, usually with 5 or more vendor bids.

quote: The Procurement team negotiates SaaS contracts >$25k and one-time contracts >$100K
fact: Procurement negotiates SaaS contracts over $25k and one-time contracts over $100K.

quote: For existing vendors, a full privacy review is required every 24 months
fact: Existing vendors need a full privacy review every 24 months.

quote: CFO and Board approvals should be obtained no less than 18 months prior to the event dates.
fact: For internal events costing over $1M (like SKO), CFO and Board approval must come at least 18 months before the event.

quote: reviews are required for vendors that collect, process, or store Orange / Red Data, software providers (SaaS and On-premise), and independent contractors / consultants.
fact: Security third-party risk reviews are required for vendors handling Orange/Red data, all software providers, and independent contractors.

quote: All invoices are subject to a 10% PO tolerance.
fact: Invoices may exceed their PO by up to 10%; overages above $1,000 need a PO change request.

quote: Team meals of up to 20 people which should not exceed $100 per person
fact: A Navan purchasing card can pay for team meals of up to 20 people at no more than $100 per person.

quote: We anticipate that our quarterly trading window will open the third trading day after the
fact: The quarterly trading window opens on the third trading day after quarterly results are announced.

quote: The Committee shall meet at the discretion of the chair, but not less than once per quarter.
fact: The Disclosure Committee meets at least once per quarter.

quote: GitLab establishes [$5,000 (USD)](/handbook/total-rewards/compensation/#exchange-rates) as the minimum amount required for capitalization.
fact: Items costing $5,000 or more are capitalized; cheaper items are expensed on purchase.

quote: Fifty (50) percent of the balances that are Ninety (90) days or more after the due date and One Hundred (100) percent of the balances that are One Hundred and Twenty (120) days or more after the due date are reserved as allowance for doubtful debt.
fact: Half of receivables 90+ days past due and all receivables 120+ days past due are reserved as doubtful debt.

quote: The duration limit for contingent workers who are considered "staff augmentation workers" is 24 months.
fact: Staff augmentation contingent workers can work at most 24 months, then need a 3-month unpaid break.

quote: GitLab will only contract with contingent workers in India, the Philippines, and jurisdictions where GitLab has an entity.
fact: Contingent workers can only be hired in India, the Philippines, or countries where GitLab has an entity.

quote: The AOP is approved by the board of directors every year.
fact: The Annual Operating Plan is approved by the board of directors each year.

quote: Our goal is to have revenue and EBIT variance percentage within +/- 2% on a quarterly basis.
fact: FP&A aims to keep revenue and EBIT variance within plus or minus 2% each quarter.

quote: An individual's annual expenditure on Individual Use software should not surpass $5,000.
fact: Individual use software is capped at $5,000 per person per year; above that, use the procurement process.

quote: Please be aware that the role of CFO Shadow will place you on the Designated Insider list for that quarter.
fact: A CFO Shadow is put on the Designated Insider list for that quarter and must get pre-clearance to trade.

quote: The expected `Close Won` to invoice cycle is 24-48 hours depending on the complexity of the related opportunity.
fact: Billing aims to invoice within 24-48 hours after a deal is marked Close Won.

quote: A link to the GitLab issue describing the vulnerability, which will remain confidential until 30 days after the release in which the vulnerability was patched
fact: Vulnerability issues shared with JiHu stay confidential until 30 days after the patch release.

quote: if the donation is >$5,000, we will need to set the recipient up in Coupa and follow the PO process in order to issue payment
fact: Donations over $5,000 need the recipient set up in Coupa and a PO; smaller ones are paid by AP as a PO exception.
